# AHat4Pat

> Small video editing studio based in Trois-Rivières, Québec, working for clients everywhere. "You film. We cut."

## Offer
- Single Cut (founding offer): one video in (up to 10 minutes of raw footage), one finished video out (under 90 seconds), captioned, ready to post, in 48 hours. $49 USD for the first 10 clients, then $75.
- Send It: small jobs (subtitles, transcripts, translation EN/FR/ES, clean-ups), from $50.
- The Cutting Room: editing for freelancers and creators.
- The Workshop: video campaigns, brand film and the systems behind them, for companies. By quote.
